subject: Mid-quarter governance readout: proposed re-scopes and resource asks
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jared Mills <jared@orchidhealth.io>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@atlascloud.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter governance readout: proposed re-scopes and resource asks

Team —

Quick mid-quarter readout ahead of the QBR: I pulled together the key asks and a recommended re-scope for Objective 2 (Serving Runtime). High-level: the objective is behind on two KRs due to increased infra contention and delayed benchmarking of quantized variants. If we do nothing, we risk missing our latency SLO and that will show up clearly in the QBR.

Key status highlights (brief):
- Objective 2 overall: 55% complete (target 75% at this point)
- KR2 (end-to-end 99th latency improvement): 30% complete — blocked by infra quota and a missing small-batch kernel fix
- KR3 (cost-per-token reduction via quantization): 40% complete — need a 1-week dedicated QA pass and model-variant signoff

Proposed tactical re-scope and asks (for leadership approval before the QBR):
1) Short-term re-scope: reduce KR2 target from -20% to -12% and move the remaining work into a follow-up sprint (Q3 week 2). Rationale: preserves customer promises while keeping runway for the baseline rollout.
2) Resource reallocation: temporarily move 2 SWE ICs from Growth infra to the Serving runtime team for 4 weeks (prefer 6, but propose 4 as conservative). These engineers will address the small-batch kernel and integration test fixes.
3) Infra priority: request a short-term GPU quota bump in us-west-2 for benchmarking and a 24/7 slot for a 3-day performance run (Ellen, can Atlas help accelerate?)
4) Legal/compliance: expedited review for the quantized-model validation checklist (we may need a data residency exception for a canary test).
5) Sales/CS ask: Jared — please pause the Orchard Health rollout scheduled for Aug 2 if we cannot sign off on the quantized variant by July 30.

Attachments: I attached a 1-pager for the QBR, an OKR risk matrix, and a short slide deck with a proposed timeline.

Request: Please confirm approvals (items 1–3) or provide alternatives by EOD Monday so I can lock the QBR narrative. If you want, we can take a 20-min sync Monday at 9:30am.

Thanks —
Ava
Ava Chen
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_prep_one_pager.pdf (1 page), OKR_risk_matrix.xlsx (3 sheets), proposed_realloc_slides.pptx (6 slides)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jared Mills <jared@orchidhealth.io>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter governance readout: proposed re-scopes and resource asks

Thanks Ava — good summary. A couple of quick points:

- On the FTE move: I can free up headcount but only for 4 weeks, not 6, given Growth's delivery calendar and upcoming demos. If we agree to 4 weeks, I need a focused scope for the two engineers (clear tickets and acceptance criteria).
- On the GPU quota: Ellen, is a temporary bump of +8 A100s for a 72-hour benchmark run possible, or can Atlas provide a temporary burst in a nearby region?
- On the KR re-targeting: I don't love lowering KR ambition, but given cascading risk to our SLA, trimming KR2 to -12% is defensible. Please add expected customer-facing impact in one paragraph (what customers will see/don't see) so I can sign off.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ava: add a one-paragraph impact statement for customers and reduce the reallocation ask to 4 weeks in the deck.
2) Laura/Marissa: if you can provisionally approve the 4-week reassign, we'll route the change through HR and update the sprint boards.

-Vivek
VP, Platform Engineering

Subject: Re: Mid-quarter governance readout: proposed re-scopes and resource asks

Ava — thanks for the clear ask. I will provisionally approve the 4-week reallocation of 2 ICs on the condition that you provide: 

- A one-paragraph customer impact statement (Vivek requested this)
- A short QA plan for the quantized variant (timeline + owner)
- A rollback trigger and communications plan if latency regressions occur in the canary

Marissa — can you block the headcount and coordinate the temporary assignment with Growth's PM? If HR needs any paperwork, loop me in; we should treat this as a formal temporary assignment with clear dates.

Ava, please update the deck and I will finalize the approval. We should also capture this decision in the QBR appendix so the execs see the tradeoff.

-Laura
VP, Product

Thanks all — updated plan below and attached updated slides.

Updates: 
- Realloc ask reduced to 4 weeks (July 27–Aug 23). Two named tickets for the ICs: INF-1427 (small-batch kernel fix, owner: Priya), INF-1432 (integration flaky test stabilization, owner: Sam). Acceptance criteria listed on slide 3.
- Customer impact paragraph (to include in QBR): 
  "We expect a partial latency improvement on the baseline serving path; customers with strict 99th latency needs may see no material change from today until the follow-up sprint in Q3. No data loss or feature regressions expected. We will pause Orchid Health's quantized canary unless signoff occurs by Jul 30."
- QA plan: 3-day dedicated QA window (Aug 16–18) with owners, test checklist, and rollback trigger (p95 or error-rate regression threshold).
- Infra: Ellen confirmed a +6 A100 temporary bump in us-west-2 for a 72-hour run; Atlas will coordinate provisioning and cost.

Next actions:
- Laura: finalize approval in the QBR appendix (if agreed, I'll mark as "approved (conditional)")
- Marissa: please start the temporary assignment paperwork and update the sprint boards by EOD tomorrow
- Jared: I'll follow up separately on the external rollout timing for Orchid Health; for now we'll tentatively pause the Aug 2 canary unless we hit the July 30 signoff.

I'll post the updated slides to the Drive link and the JIRA tickets referenced above. Thanks for the quick turn.

Ava
